title.suggested: Allen Interviewed Before the Hogan Fight

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported on preparations for the Allen-Hogan fight and interviewed Allen at his Saturday night free and easy, where he refused to say whether he was training.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The St. Louis Democrat, Monday, October 6, 1873 (Daily Democrat). The paper calls itself the DEMOCRAT in the text.

facts.fact: Asked whether he was training for the Hogan fight, Allen refused to say
facts.quote: A prize-fighter is like a race-horse. It don't do to let people know what he is doing. I ain't a-doing nothing.

facts.fact: Allen presided at his Saturday night free and easy at his saloon
Allen was to appear at Johnny Farrell's booth during St. Louis Fair week
Betting favored Allen over Hogan, in some cases two to one

notes: Allen also quoted Shakespeare ('all the world's a stage') about a drunk who offered to back him.
